remarks: You will love this very spacious triple-wide manufactured home in the highly-sought-after Ventura Marina Senior Community, located across from the beautiful Ventura Harbor. This property has brand new flooring and fresh interior/exterior paint throughout, as well as Plantation shutters. The primary bedroom includes a sitting area, as well. Home features a fireplace for those chilly evenings, as well as a brand new deck for your relaxation and entertaining. This is a very active senior community, offering a new fully-equipped fitness center, heated pool, hot tub, clubhouse for private parties, as well as scheduled events throughout the year.
